scope: Four 2D sail concepts, not imported meshes or gameplay changes. Small triangular headsail, Medium gaff mainsail, Large square sail and Large dark-red prologue variant. Shapes are visual proposals; dimensions, recipes and balance unchanged.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original Elitewake modular sail concept, individual transparent cutout.
Reference image 1 is weathered realistic historical craftsmanship STYLE reference only, do not reproduce the boat.
Primary request: ONE compact triangular jib / headsail cloth, off-white natural linen, reinforced corners and rope boltrope perimeter. A practical triangular silhouette for small craft or the sloop headsail.
Style: premium 2026 realistic game asset, physically based fabric, detailed woven flax cloth, believable seams, subtle salt weathering, few modest stitched repairs. Strong serviceable sail, not tattered. One entire fully unfurled sail, isolated centered with all corners fully visible and generous margin. Almost front-facing with slight three-quarter depth and gentle wind-filled belly. Neutral soft studio light.
Constraints: ONLY sail cloth and its sewn-in rope edging and corner attachment loops. No mast, spars, yard, boom, gaff, pole, stand, hull, socket, backdrop, scenery, crew, text, logo, watermark or pirate skull. True transparent alpha background, no painted shadow or glow. No new speed/handling/cargo roles. Shapes are visual concepts, not balance decisions.
